tests.name: Output shape
tests.code:
import torch, math
torch.manual_seed(42)
B, S, D = 2, 4, 8
Q = torch.randn(B, S, D)
K = torch.randn(B, S, D)
V = torch.randn(B, S, D)
out = {fn}(Q, K, V)
assert out.shape == (B, S, D), f'Shape mismatch: {out.shape} vs {(B, S, D)}'

tests.name: Numerical correctness
tests.code:
import torch, math
torch.manual_seed(42)
B, S, D = 2, 4, 8
Q = torch.randn(B, S, D)
K = torch.randn(B, S, D)
V = torch.randn(B, S, D)
out = {fn}(Q, K, V)
scores = torch.bmm(Q, K.transpose(1, 2)) / math.sqrt(D)
weights = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
ref = torch.bmm(weights, V)
assert torch.allclose(out, ref, atol=1e-5), 'Value mismatch vs reference'
